break_points.what: "Shoot This Shot", the Keyframe/Cinema Shot "Run" buttons and "Run Pipeline" all fail with "No unambiguous pipeline step matches this shot and media column". The new production's pipeline (the showcase line) has three unfiltered steps writing Keyframe and four writing Cinema Shot (ui/src/studioModel.js studioRunInput needs one). "Preview allocation" routes both shots to h3-short-video-v3 (not installed), one "Dispatch blocked: Required media is missing". Workaround: Comfy Pipeline > step > Test Sample > Test This Step, then apply the proposal.

A screenplay pasted in New Production is saved as one paragraph with hard breaks (writingStartHandoff.js plainDocument), and scenes are split per block, so the 3-scene script was one scene ("Split scene" disabled). Numbered headings ("1. INT. ...") never count as scene headings (six copies of the HEADING rule). Workaround: delete the numbers, then Backspace + Enter at each heading in the editor.

No cast cards for the screenplay's people: character detection knows "Character:" lines, "NAME: line" cues and names followed by said/asked/turned/ran, not standard cues (a name alone on a line). The crew breakdown also folds cue lines into the paragraph. All 11 shots were B-roll with no cast. Workaround: add the characters on the Cast & sets wall, then "Who is in this shot" (it added Nora; for "Eli runs toward us" it answered "no change", Eli was added by hand).

The new production's working screenplay is the template's "The Last Signal" brief, so the user's screenplay lands as a private draft; adopting it takes Versions > Compare > Preview adopting whole manuscript > Adopt > Apply.

Template content leaks into a production made from a story: Kael @CAST-01, Observatory @SET-01, three Kael shot rows (kept by the storyboard build, "The 4 shots you have are kept") and an OpenJutsu row VFX-01 in the film's provenance warning.

Scene 1 (no @SET tag) got SET-01 by scene index, which is the template's Observatory; scene 3 at the same location got a separate SET-03. Art then folded scene-1 text into the Observatory description. Fixed by hand on the shot.

The pre-production panel froze at "6 of 22 jobs finished" for about 9 minutes although all 22 jobs finished by 21:39:43: no GET /preproduction reached the server after 21:34:59 until the panel was remounted, and the stage was settled only by that next GET. Suspect: the poll re-arms only on a state change, so one failed load stops it (PreproductionPanel.jsx).

The grade panel stayed on "Grading..." with "Connection lost or session expired" while the grade (90/100) was already stored; its 3 s poll stopped after one failed fetch. A 40-request burst returned 40/40, so the server backlog is not the cause; the failed fetch was not explained.

Chinese strings in the English UI ("第 N 列" in proposal reviews, the step-test warning, "![圖片](...)" image cells shown as raw markdown); the Needs You list labels every Art proposal "Soul Cast"; the 3D plan for a dam walkway says "lateral tracking along the console" (observatory vocabulary) and was rejected; Camera Motion gets the raw solver word ("track", "dolly in"); the "Let the crew pre-produce" card and "Proposal ready above." hints stay after the flow and the proposals are done; pipeline-made takes are labelled "unknown manuscript"; the SC02-S02 keyframe put a second runner in frame (FLUX), which the grader caught.
